diagnostic_relation_probe.interpretation: Single hosted-run diagnostic evidence only. The strict CSR arm is cheaper than TensorView on this specific construction/query workload but remains far slower in query latency than the preindexed Forest arm. This is negative/falsification evidence against treating the current CSR projection as an automatic performance win and is not a benchmark superiority claim.

verification.claim: Hosted CI is claimed only for exact test revision 239cee119999a6e9bb2625e67d8855ad6187f751. The docs/evidence commits after that revision are not used to extend the green-CI claim. Repository-wide evidence is collection-only, not full-suite execution. Diagnostic timings are retained as one-hosted-run falsification evidence and do not establish comparative superiority.

review.adversarial_regression: The probe asserts exact result equality across all four arms and separately asserts that the CSR block binds the mechanically complete Fourfold digest. Existing strict adapter tests continue to refuse partial endpoint planes, wrong Forest identity, retained hyperedges, and undirected retained edges.
